items.t: US forces disable ship trying to run Iran blockade
items.d: CENTCOM says it disabled the Palau-flagged bulk carrier Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman after it left Bandar Abbas; the crew were unharmed. Iran vowed to resist the blockade, raising the risk to Gulf shipping.

items.t: Drone strike in Kuwait kills two Italian technicians
items.d: The pair were working on an air-defence system; four others were hurt. Italy and Kuwait blame Iran, which denies involvement, and UN chief Guterres condemned the attack.

items.t: EU summit ends without budget or Ukraine loan deal
items.d: Leaders failed to agree the 2028-2034 budget or a proposed $49bn loan for Ukraine, though Council President Costa says 24 states back the loan. Talks resume in December.

items.t: Russia fires 155 drones at Ukraine; Kyiv hits St Petersburg
items.d: Ukraine says 110 drones were downed, but attacks over a day killed six and cut power in six regions. Ukrainian drones targeted St Petersburg, with 44 reportedly intercepted.

items.t: Russian convoy to Libya turns back after corvette sunk
items.d: Reuters sources say a Russian naval convoy carrying military vehicles turned around after Ukrainian sea drones sank a Russian corvette at Benghazi. Italy says it was not told of the strike.

items.t: Venezuela to scrap ban on opposition holding office
items.d: The move comes a month after opposition leader María Corina Machado returned home, a sign of political opening in Caracas.

items.t: Kenyan cult leader convicted over 123 deaths
items.d: A court found Paul Mackenzie guilty of manslaughter over followers who starved in the Shakahola forest; he is already serving a 200-year sentence.

items.t: Iran says two tankers exploded near Strait of Hormuz
items.d: The Revolutionary Guards say the tankers blew up near Khasab, Oman, while using a US-backed shipping corridor. The claim is unverified but adds to oil-supply worries.

items.t: US pushed Venezuela and Iraq to consider quitting OPEC
items.d: Reuters, citing ten sources, reports the Trump administration encouraged both to leave OPEC this year and blocked Venezuela from paying its dues, a challenge to the cartel's grip on prices.

items.t: Argentina passes Milei's central bank overhaul
items.d: The new charter bars the central bank from lending to any level of government or financing the Treasury, a key plank of Milei's fight against inflation.

items.t: US chip curbs slow China's AI labs
items.d: Reuters reports Z.AI has fallen behind on its next flagship model and Moonshot AI expects longer gaps between releases. Nvidia reportedly paused server shipments to several Southeast Asian countries.

items.t: Huawei teases AI memory chip to rival Samsung, SK Hynix
items.d: Huawei previewed next-generation high-bandwidth memory for AI, aiming to compete with Samsung and SK Hynix as China seeks to cut reliance on foreign chips.

items.t: Microsoft: state hackers use AI agent framework
items.d: Microsoft says state-backed hackers use a framework called ARTEX that hands attack steps to specialised AI agents, and urges defenders to use deception tactics to catch automated attacks.

items.t: Switzerland reports five cyberattacks using AI agents
items.d: The federal cybersecurity office says the attacks hit businesses and critical-infrastructure operators, an early sign of AI agents being used in real attacks.

items.t: Hackers breach US Air Force cloud platform
items.d: Reuters sources say hackers got into the Air Force's Cloud One platform; app migration was paused and some users lost admin rights.

items.t: Canada boosts AI compute fund to C$1bn
items.d: Ottawa added C$700m and will cover up to 80% of compute costs for firms that buy from qualifying Canadian sovereign cloud providers.

items.t: Measles deaths hit record low, WHO warns of gaps
items.d: An estimated 72,000 people died of measles in 2025, down 91% since 2000. But over 29 million children missed vaccines and 59 countries had big outbreaks.

items.t: UN warns hunger will worsen in 16 hotspots
items.d: FAO and WFP say acute hunger will deepen over six months, with famine threatening parts of Africa; El Niño drives three of four new hotspots.

items.t: Reform UK wins council by-elections after racism row
items.d: Reform UK took the council seats in by-elections triggered by a racism row, another sign of its strength in local politics.

items.t: No sign DWP hack spread to other departments
items.d: The government says there is no evidence a 'malicious actor' behind an incident at the Department for Work and Pensions targeted other departments.

items.t: Badenoch: Tory candidates must back leaving ECHR
items.d: Kemi Badenoch says Conservative candidates must support quitting the European Convention on Human Rights and scrapping the net zero target.

items.t: 美軍癱瘓企圖突破伊朗封鎖的貨船
items.d: 美軍中央司令部表示，在阿曼灣癱瘓一艘從阿巴斯港出發的帕勞籍散貨船「Pacific Archer」，船員無恙。伊朗誓言抵抗封鎖，海灣航運風險加劇。

items.t: 科威特遭無人機襲擊　兩名意大利技術人員死亡
items.d: 兩人當時正為防空系統工作，另有四人受傷。意大利及科威特指責伊朗，伊朗否認涉事，聯合國秘書長古特雷斯譴責襲擊。

items.t: 歐盟峰會未能就預算及烏克蘭貸款達成協議
items.d: 歐盟領袖未能通過2028至2034年預算，亦未批出約490億美元烏克蘭貸款，但歐洲理事會主席科斯塔指有24國支持貸款。談判將於12月再續。

items.t: 俄羅斯向烏克蘭發射155架無人機　烏方空襲聖彼得堡
items.d: 烏克蘭稱擊落其中110架，但一日內的襲擊造成六死，六個州停電。烏克蘭無人機亦攻擊聖彼得堡，據報44架被攔截。

items.t: 俄艦隊駛往利比亞途中折返
items.d: 路透社引述消息指，運載軍車的俄羅斯艦隊在烏克蘭海上無人機於班加西擊沉一艘俄國護衛艦後折返。意大利表示事前未獲通知。

items.t: 委內瑞拉將廢除禁止反對派任公職的法例
items.d: 此舉在反對派領袖馬查多回國一個月後宣布，顯示當局政治上有所鬆動。

items.t: 肯尼亞邪教頭目就123名信徒死亡被裁定誤殺罪成
items.d: 法院裁定麥肯齊誤殺罪成，事涉信徒在沙卡霍拉森林絕食死亡。他早前已被判囚200年。

items.t: 伊朗稱兩艘油輪在霍爾木茲海峽附近爆炸
items.d: 伊斯蘭革命衛隊稱，兩艘油輪在使用美國支持的航道時於阿曼海薩卜附近爆炸。說法未經證實，但加深市場對石油供應的憂慮。

items.t: 美國曾游說委內瑞拉及伊拉克考慮退出油組
items.d: 路透社引述十名消息人士報道，特朗普政府今年曾鼓勵兩國退出油組，並阻止委內瑞拉繳交會費，挑戰油組對油價的影響力。

items.t: 阿根廷國會通過米萊央行改革
items.d: 新章程禁止央行向任何級別政府借貸或為財政部融資，是米萊對抗通脹的重要措施。

items.t: 美國晶片管制拖慢中國AI研發
items.d: 路透社報道，Z.AI下一代旗艦模型進度落後，Moonshot AI預計新版本相隔時間會拉長。據報Nvidia暫停向多個東南亞國家付運伺服器。

items.t: 華為預告新一代AI記憶體晶片
items.d: 華為預告新一代AI高頻寬記憶體，目標與Samsung及SK Hynix競爭，反映中國力求減少依賴外國晶片。

items.t: Microsoft：國家級黑客利用AI代理框架發動攻擊
items.d: Microsoft指國家支持的黑客使用名為ARTEX的框架，把攻擊步驟交由不同AI代理執行，並建議以誘騙技術偵測自動化攻擊。

items.t: 瑞士錄得五宗利用AI代理的網絡攻擊
items.d: 瑞士聯邦網絡安全辦公室表示，攻擊對象包括企業及關鍵基建營運者，顯示AI代理已被用於實際攻擊。

items.t: 黑客入侵美國空軍雲端平台
items.d: 路透社消息指黑客入侵美國空軍Cloud One平台，應用程式遷移工作暫停，部分用戶失去管理員權限。

items.t: 加拿大AI運算基金增至10億加元
items.d: 加拿大政府注資7億加元，企業若向合資格的本地主權雲端供應商購買運算服務，可獲資助最多八成費用。

items.t: 世衞：麻疹死亡人數創新低但接種缺口仍大
items.d: 2025年估計有72,000人死於麻疹，較2000年減少91%。但逾2,900萬名兒童未有接種疫苗，59個國家爆發嚴重疫情。

items.t: 聯合國警告16個熱點地區飢荒惡化
items.d: 糧農組織及世界糧食計劃署指，未來六個月嚴重飢餓情況將惡化，非洲部分地區面臨飢荒威脅，四個新熱點中有三個受厄爾尼諾影響。

items.t: 英國改革黨贏得種族言論風波引發的議會補選
items.d: 改革黨在因種族言論風波而舉行的地方議會補選中勝出，再次顯示其在地方政壇的實力。

items.t: 當局：無證據DWP事故波及其他部門
items.d: 政府表示，沒有證據顯示工作及退休保障部事故背後的「惡意人士」曾針對其他部門。

items.t: 貝丁諾：保守黨候選人須支持退出歐洲人權公約
items.d: 保守黨領袖貝丁諾表示，黨內候選人必須支持退出《歐洲人權公約》及廢除淨零排放目標。
